say:1:1322124001:1.text: I was wondering when you'd come back! Recently, I found a method in an old Bantus scroll that can suppress mad Graveborn.
say:1:1322124001:1.source_cn: 你们来了，真巧，我正想去找你们。前些天我在一份来自班题...

say:2:1322124002:1.text: I spent a few days studying it and talked it over with Valka. We believe this method could be effective on the undead here!
say:2:1322124002:1.source_cn: 我研究了几天，也找瓦丽卡姐姐讨论过，我们都觉得这个方法...

choice_prompt:3:1322124002.text: I spent a few days studying it and talked it over with Valka. We believe this method could be effective on the undead here!
choice_prompt:3:1322124002.source_cn: 我研究了几天，也找瓦丽卡姐姐讨论过，我们都觉得这个方法或许对活死人也有用。

say:4:1322124003:1.text: The undead here are like Graveborn who have lost all their reasoning... Considering everything that we've seen, they do have similarities to a type of madness.
say:4:1322124003:1.source_cn: 活死人就是失去了理智的亡灵……仔细想想，和“发狂”确实...

say:5:1322124005:1.text: The scroll says that if you can find what triggered the madness in the Graveborn and repeatedly expose them to it, there's a chance they might regain some sanity, even if only briefly.
say:5:1322124005:1.source_cn: 文献里记载，如果能找到发狂亡灵的刺激源——也就是让他们...

say:6:1322124006:1.text: During this brief period of clarity, the mad Graveborn can regain some self-control and may even be fully subdued by strong enough Divine Light.
say:6:1322124006:1.source_cn: 在这段有理智的时间内，发狂的亡灵能够进行一定程度的自我...

say:7:1322124007:1.text: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?
say:7:1322124007:1.source_cn: 所以你的意思是……先想办法让活死人找回记忆和理智，然后...
say:7:1322124007:1.male: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?
say:7:1322124007:1.female: So you're saying we first need to help the undead regain some of their memory and sanity and then purify them with Divine Light?

say:8:1322124008:1.text: With so many undead, how can we possibly help them regain even a bit of memory and sanity? Even a few seconds seems impossible...
say:8:1322124008:1.source_cn: 那么多活死人，我们该怎样才能让他们找回一定记忆和理智？...

say:9:1322124009:1.text: Valka said she would find a way to solve this problem. My task is to find an acolyte who is willing to help us.
say:9:1322124009:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐说她会想办法解决这个问题，而我得去找愿意帮助...

say:10:1322124010:1.text: Next, I want to have a serious discussion with the head of the temple and hope they'll assist me in using the Divine Light to purify the undead.
say:10:1322124010:1.source_cn: 所以……接下来我想和修道院的负责人好好谈一谈，希望他们...

choice_prompt:11:1322124010.text: Next, I want to have a serious discussion with the head of the temple and hope they'll assist me in using the Divine Light to purify the undead.
choice_prompt:11:1322124010.source_cn: 所以……接下来我想和修道院的负责人好好谈一谈，希望他们能协助我，用圣光的力量来试着净化活死人。

say:12:1322124011:1.text: I've got an idea! Ogden and Maxim, the acolytes we saved, are friendly with us. We could ask them for assistance.
say:12:1322124011:1.source_cn: 我有个想法，那两位被我们救过的修士——奥格列和马克西姆...

say:13:1322124012:1.text: Of course! They have to help us! We're their heroes!
say:13:1322124012:1.source_cn: 对呀！我们曾经救过他们，他们应该会愿意帮助我们！

say:14:1322124013:1.text: We'll go to the temple with you, Carolina. Acolyte Ogden and Maxim are good people. Tell them your reasons, and I'm sure they'll agree to help.
say:14:1322124013:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我们和你一起去修道院吧。他们两位都是虔诚又善...

say:15:1322124014:1.text: Thank you. It looks like I'll need you to accompany me through the <style="highlight">secret passage to the temple</style> once again.
say:15:1322124014:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们。看来又得麻烦你们和我一起<style=hig...

choice:11:0:1.text: We have to go to the temple then.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 看来不得不去修道院了
choice:11:0:1.male: We have to go to the temple then.
choice:11:0:1.female: We have to go to the temple then.

choice:11:1:2.text: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 奥格列和马克西姆或许可以帮忙
choice:11:1:2.male: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.
choice:11:1:2.female: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim can help.

choice:3:0:1.text: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 发狂的亡灵和活死人确实很相似
choice:3:0:1.male: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.
choice:3:0:1.female: Mad Graveborn and the undead here are similar.

say:17:1322124004:1.text: Yes, and they have a lot of in-depth research on gravecalling magic and Graveborn history.
say:17:1322124004:1.source_cn: 嗯，他们对亡灵法术和亡灵本身都有着很深入的研究。

choice:3:1:2.text: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 班题斯不愧是亡灵帝国
choice:3:1:2.male: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.
choice:3:1:2.female: Bantus is truly a Graveborn kingdom.

say:1:1322125001:1.text: The exit of the secret passage can't be opened... I can detect a seal of Divine Light.
say:1:1322125001:1.source_cn: 密道的出口……打不开了，我能感觉到有圣光封印的力量。

say:2:1322125002:1.text: Chippy can't believe they actually sealed off the passage! Are they really that terrified of the undead? What a bunch of cowards! And they dare call themselves acolytes of Dura!
say:2:1322125002:1.source_cn: 那些修士和修女果然把密道给封死了！他们就这么害怕亡灵吗...

say:3:1322125003:1.text: Don't be too hard on them, Sir Chippy. I understand their fear. If a Hypogean claiming to be good asked for my help, I'd feel scared and unsure as well.
say:3:1322125003:1.source_cn: 满满先生，请不要责怪他们，我能理解他们的惊慌。如果有一...

say:4:1322125004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
say:4:1322125004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
say:4:1322125004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?

choice_prompt:5:1322125004.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，能麻烦你们和我一起将这个封印解除吗？
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?

narration:6:1322125005:1.text: A cluster of magical light flickers and fades as you silently undo the seal guarding the exit of the secret passage. The air grows still. The path forward is open.

say:0:1322126001:0.text: Doesn't seem to be anyone nearby. The acolytes may be inside the temple.
say:0:1322126001:0.source_cn: 附近没有人……那两位修士可能在教堂里。

say:1:1322126002:0.text: Let's enter the temple from my tomb. We won't be seen.
say:1:1322126002:0.source_cn: 那么还是从我的墓穴进入大教堂吧。小心点，别被人看到了。

say:1:1322127001:1.text: Oh, Carolina's tomb has been sealed!
say:1:1322127001:1.source_cn: 呀，卡列琳娜的坟墓……也被封印了！

say:2:1322127002:1.text: It seems telling them about Carolina last time had the exact opposite effect of what we hoped for...
say:2:1322127002:1.source_cn: 看来上次告诉他们谈过卡列琳娜的事情之后，反而出现了和预...

say:3:1322127003:1.text: How could the acolytes treat the tomb of the deceased like this?! Thankfully, it's just a seal and didn't damage the tomb itself, but still!
say:3:1322127003:1.source_cn: 圣职者怎么可以这样对待亡者的坟墓呢？！还好只是封印，并...

say:4:1322127004:1.text: Don't worry. This is just temporary. Eventually, they'll come to understand us Graveborn in time.
say:4:1322127004:1.source_cn: 别担心，我相信这只是暂时的……最终他们一定会愿意重新去...

say:5:1322127005:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...
say:5:1322127005:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...
say:5:1322127005:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...

narration:6:1322127006:1.text: Once certain no one is nearby, you quietly unravel the seal with practiced ease. The magic that might awe others is nothing more than a simple task in your capable hands.

say:0:1322128001:0.text: Hurry! Don't let anyone see you.
say:0:1322128001:0.source_cn: 快从这里下去，不要被人看到了。
say:0:1322128001:0.male: Hurry! Don't let anyone see you.
say:0:1322128001:0.female: Hurry! Don't let anyone see you.

say:0:1322129001:0.source_cn: 看，奥格列在那里！我们去找他。

say:1:1322131001:1.source_cn: 奥格列修士，发生了什么事？

say:2:1322131002:1.text: Dura above! The goddess has sent you again! I knew she wouldn't abandon her most devoted in such a desperate situation!
say:2:1322131002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！是女神的使者……我就知道艾雅不会让我等虔诚之...

choice_prompt:3:1322131002.text: Dura above! The goddess has sent you again! I knew she wouldn't abandon her most devoted in such a desperate situation!
choice_prompt:3:1322131002.source_cn: 艾雅在上！是女神的使者……我就知道艾雅不会让我等虔诚之人陷入这般绝望的境地！

say:4:1322131003:1.text: That's right. You have to help me!
say:4:1322131003:1.source_cn: 正是如此，请你们务必帮帮我！

say:5:1322131005:0.text: This morning, Brother Maxim took Sister Theresa and Brother Ferin to St. Valesa's Temple. We've hired some workers to do a bit of renovation there.
say:5:1322131005:0.source_cn: 今天一早，马克西姆兄弟带着特里莎姐妹、费尔德南兄弟去圣...

say:6:1322131006:1.text: Just now, these two friends mentioned they were surrounded by a group of undead.
say:6:1322131006:1.source_cn: 但刚才这两位好心的朋友说……说他们被一群活死人围住了！

say:9:1322131007:0.text: Yes! Yes! We went to fix the temple, but out of nowhere, a horde of undead showed up near the lake!
say:9:1322131007:0.source_cn: 对对对……我们是去维修教堂的，结果湖区那边突然出现了好...

say:10:1322131008:1.text: The acolytes couldn't stop the undead, and they were all injured! Luckily, the two of us were taking a break, so we didn't get surrounded. We rushed back immediately to ask for help.
say:10:1322131008:1.source_cn: 那几位修士修女根本挡不住那些活死人，全都受伤了！我们两...

say:11:1322131009:1.source_cn: 求求你们，一定要把他们救出来啊！

say:14:1322131010:1.text: Don't worry! Leave it to us!
say:14:1322131010:1.source_cn: 放心，交给我们吧！我们现在就出发！

say:15:1322131011:1.text: I'll accompany you. I can help.
say:15:1322131011:1.source_cn: 我也和你们一起去，我能帮上忙。

say:16:1322131012:1.text: Y-you're the one who appeared at the funeral a few days ago... Carolina...
say:16:1322131012:1.source_cn: 你……你是前几天葬礼仪式里出现过的那位……卡、卡列琳娜...

choice_prompt:17:1322131012.text: Y-you're the one who appeared at the funeral a few days ago... Carolina...
choice_prompt:17:1322131012.source_cn: 你……你是前几天葬礼仪式里出现过的那位……卡、卡列琳娜……你……

say:18:1322131013:1.text: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.
say:18:1322131013:1.source_cn: 你……你是女神的使者。艾雅在上，我……我相信你的话……...
say:18:1322131013:1.male: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.
say:18:1322131013:1.female: Dura has sent you, so I'll trust your words. Please, don't let this evil continue.

say:19:1322131014:1.source_cn: 总之……我们，我们先去救人！

choice:17:0:1.text: Don't be scared. She's with us.
choice:17:0:1.male: Don't be scared. She's with us.
choice:17:0:1.female: Don't be scared. She's with us.

choice:17:1:2.text: She is also a follower of Dura.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 她也是女神虔诚的信徒
choice:17:1:2.male: She is also a follower of Dura.
choice:17:1:2.female: She is also a follower of Dura.

say:21:1322131004:1.text: Without a doubt, she sent you.
say:21:1322131004:1.male: Without a doubt, she sent you.
say:21:1322131004:1.female: Without a doubt, she sent you.

choice:3:2:3.text: I wonder if Dura did send me...
choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 我都怀疑我真是女神的使者了
choice:3:2:3.male: I wonder if Dura did send me...
choice:3:2:3.female: I wonder if Dura did send me...

say:0:1322132001:0.source_cn: 他们在那里，快点，还来得及！

say:1:1322134001:1.text: Bless Dura, thank you all! I really thought I was going to die here.
say:1:1322134001:1.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，谢谢你们！刚才……刚才我一度真的以为我要死在...

choice_prompt:2:1322134001.text: Bless Dura, thank you all! I really thought I was going to die here.
choice_prompt:2:1322134001.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，谢谢你们！刚才……刚才我一度真的以为我要死在这里了。

say:3:1322134002:1.text: We were all injured and couldn't hold out much longer... Luckily, you came.
say:3:1322134002:1.source_cn: 我们都受了伤，快要撑不住了……还好你们赶来了。

say:5:1322134004:1.text: Our injuries aren't too serious... That... that talking Graveborn showed up just in time. Goddess, I must be losing my mind. How could an undead have saved us?!
say:5:1322134004:1.source_cn: 伤得不算太重……那个，那个……那个会讲话的活死人……来...

say:7:1322134005:1.text: Dura above, I can't believe it... But indeed, it's what happened...
say:7:1322134005:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我也不敢相信，但……事实的确如此，刚才大家都...

say:9:1322134006:1.text: The Graveborn you just encountered is Igor. He might look unusual, but he's a gentle soul with a heart as innocent as a child's.
say:9:1322134006:1.source_cn: 刚才那位亡灵名叫伊戈尔，他虽然相貌怪异，但是位很有童心...

say:11:1322134007:1.text: Yes, and Carolina isn't a bad person either. Even as a Graveborn, she's just as kind as she was in life and not as frightening as you might think!
say:11:1322134007:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜也不是坏人。他们虽然已经成为了亡灵，但依旧和生...

choice_prompt:12:1322134007.text: Yes, and Carolina isn't a bad person either. Even as a Graveborn, she's just as kind as she was in life and not as frightening as you might think!
choice_prompt:12:1322134007.source_cn: 卡列琳娜也不是坏人。他们虽然已经成为了亡灵，但依旧和生前一样善良，并没有你们想象得那样恐怖！

say:14:1322134008:1.text: Yeah, Graveborn, like Igor and Carolina, are nothing like the crazy undead around here!
say:14:1322134008:1.source_cn: 更何况，伊戈尔和卡列琳娜这样的亡灵与那些活死人一点都不一样！

say:16:1322134009:1.text: Most of the undead here have gone mad, but Carolina and Igor, like us, can think clearly and feel emotions.
say:16:1322134009:1.source_cn: 活死人已经没有理智了，但卡列琳娜、伊戈尔他们和我们大家...

say:17:1322134010:1.text: I-I don't really understand, but, Dura above, they're definitely different from the other undead. I've never seen Graveborn like them before.
say:17:1322134010:1.source_cn: 我……我不明白，艾雅在上，但他们的确和活死人不同。我以...

say:20:1322134011:1.text: Lady Carolina, please allow us to apologize for our earlier behavior and to thank you...
say:20:1322134011:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜女士，请允许我们向您致谢和道歉……

say:21:1322134012:1.text: The goddess encourages us to be kind and considerate. I understand your fear, so I hold no grudges. However, there's something I hope you can assist me with.
say:21:1322134012:1.source_cn: 女神教导我们要懂得体谅他人，我明白你们的恐惧，所以我不...

say:22:1322134013:1.text: The Graveborn need our help? What's the problem?
say:22:1322134013:1.source_cn: 亡灵需要我们帮助？是什么事情？

choice_prompt:23:1322134013.text: The Graveborn need our help? What's the problem?
choice_prompt:23:1322134013.source_cn: 亡灵需要我们帮助？是什么事情？

say:24:1322134014:1.text: This matter requires our cooperation. If successful, the undead will no longer be a threat to the people of Whiteridge.
say:24:1322134014:1.source_cn: 这件事需要我们合作。如果成功了，活死人就不会再成为白山...

say:25:1322134015:1.text: The undead were once soldiers in the First Divine War, and they were heroes of Whiteridge. I hope we can purify them in the Divine Light and have them rest in peace in the tranquil kingdom of the goddess.
say:25:1322134015:1.source_cn: 那些活死人，他们曾是第一次神魔战争时的士兵，是白山的英...

say:26:1322134016:1.text: I'm deeply moved by what you've said. But you know we lack the strength to confront the undead... May Dura bless you.
say:26:1322134016:1.source_cn: 我承认我被你打动了。可你们很清楚，我们的力量太弱，根本...

say:28:1322134017:1.text: I-I need to be honest. Even though I'm thankful you saved me, I can't bring myself to cooperate with the Graveborn just yet. I'm sorry... I'll pray for the goddess to bless you.
say:28:1322134017:1.source_cn: 我……我必须说实话，虽然很感激你们的救命之恩，但我目前...

say:29:1322134018:1.text: Lady Carolina... If I help, can you... can you guarantee my safety?
say:29:1322134018:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜女士，如果我帮助你们的话，你……你能保证我的安全吗？

say:30:1322134019:1.text: I swear to the goddess, your safety will always come first.
say:30:1322134019:1.source_cn: 我向女神发誓，你们的安全是第一位的。

say:31:1322134020:1.text: Then my answer is yes, I'm willing to cooperate.
say:31:1322134020:1.source_cn: 好！那么……我愿意配合你们。

say:33:1322134021:1.text: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.
say:33:1322134021:1.male: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.
say:33:1322134021:1.female: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.

say:34:1322134022:1.text: Furthermore, if we can fully purify the undead, I'll brave any danger. This is my duty as an acolyte of the goddess!
say:34:1322134022:1.source_cn: 更何况，如果真能够彻底净化活死人，哪怕有再大的危险我都...

say:35:1322134023:1.text: Acolyte Maxim, Acolyte Ogden... Thank you. Dura will surely bless and protect you.
say:35:1322134023:1.source_cn: 马克西姆修士，奥格列修士……谢谢你们，愿艾雅保佑你们。

say:36:1322134024:1.text: This matter requires Valka's assistance. She's likely around Sorrowfall Lake. We need to ask her if she's discovered a way to awaken the undead's sanity.
say:36:1322134024:1.source_cn: 这件事还需要瓦丽卡姐姐的帮助才行，她应该在哀叹之湖，我...

say:37:1322134025:1.text: Valka? Is she also a Graveborn?

say:39:1322134026:1.text: She's a mighty and kind Graveborn, the savior of Whiteridge! She's the one who took down the Frost Furie and ended the crisis. Well, Chippy did pitch in a little too.
say:39:1322134026:1.source_cn: 她是一位强大的、善良的亡灵，是白山的英雄！就是她战胜了...

say:40:1322134027:1.text: Dura above, I thought I knew Whiteridge inside and out, but you all keep shattering my understanding over and over... Once this is done, I need to dive deep into the history of the duchy.
say:40:1322134027:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我以为我已经很了解白山了，结果你们一次又一次...

say:42:1322134028:1.text: Please follow me. Let us find Valka.
say:42:1322134028:1.source_cn: 请跟我来吧，我们现在就去找瓦丽卡姐姐。

choice:23:0:1.text: A plan on how to purify the undead...
choice:23:0:1.source_cn: （讲述彻底净化活死人的计划）
choice:23:0:1.male: A plan on how to purify the undead...
choice:23:0:1.female: A plan on how to purify the undead...

choice:12:1:2.text: We only need to be wary of the crazy undead.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 该警惕的是失去理智的活死人
choice:12:1:2.male: We only need to be wary of the crazy undead.

say:0:1322135001:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐果然在这里。

say:1:1322136001:1.text: Carolina, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and our two acolytes. You must have come to me to speak of the purification of the undead.
say:1:1322136001:1.male: Carolina, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and our two acolytes. You must have come to me to speak of the purification of the undead.
say:1:1322136001:1.female: Carolina, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and our two acolytes. You must have come to me to speak of the purification of the undead.

say:2:1322136002:1.text: Yes, Valka. These two are Acolyte Ogden and Maxim. They have pledged their aid to us and try to purify the undead with the Divine Light.
say:2:1322136002:1.source_cn: 是的，瓦丽卡姐姐。这两位是奥格列修士和马克西姆修士，他...

say:3:1322136003:1.text: Excellent. In the name of those soldiers, I thank you for your assistance.
say:3:1322136003:1.source_cn: 太好了！我代表那些战士感谢你们的帮助。

say:5:1322136004:1.text: Y-you're... Dura above, you're the one honored by the Snowspire Festival, the hero who defeated the Hypogean!
say:5:1322136004:1.source_cn: 你……你是……艾雅在上，你是冬日祭典纪念的那位、那位打...

say:6:1322136005:1.text: Those are all things of the past. The Frost Furie has been sealed, and what I have to do now is to help those warriors who have become the undead regain their last dignity.
say:6:1322136005:1.source_cn: 那些都是过去的事情了。冰之恶魔已经被封印，如今我要做的...

say:7:1322136006:1.text: Valka, have you found a way to temporarily awaken the memories of the undead warriors?
say:7:1322136006:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐，你找到能够暂时唤起活死人记忆的方法了吗？

say:8:1322136007:1.text: This sword should bear some effect. Though I cannot wholly return them to consciousness and sanity, I am sure they may find their senses again, if only for a short time.
say:8:1322136007:1.source_cn: 这把剑应该能起到一定效果。虽然无法彻底让他们清醒，但短...

choice_prompt:9:1322136007.text: This sword should bear some effect. Though I cannot wholly return them to consciousness and sanity, I am sure they may find their senses again, if only for a short time.
choice_prompt:9:1322136007.source_cn: 这把剑应该能起到一定效果。虽然无法彻底让他们清醒，但短时间内，我有把握让他们找回理智。

say:10:1322136008:1.text: This sword is imbued with the strength of the God of Death and the indomitable souls of my brethren. Should I stir its power, I may yet rouse those warriors, even if briefly.
say:10:1322136008:1.source_cn: 这把剑里蕴含着死神的神力与我的战友们不屈的灵魂。如果我...

say:11:1322136009:1.text: Perchance... they still know me, their former companion, for their souls are bound to mine.
say:11:1322136009:1.source_cn: 也许……他们还记得我这位曾经的战友，因为他们的灵魂与我同在。

say:12:1322136010:1.text: I shall first wield this blade to rouse the souls of the warriors, granting them a fleeting moment to reclaim their true selves.
say:12:1322136010:1.source_cn: 我会先用这把剑唤起战士们的灵魂，让他们短暂找回自我。

say:13:1322136011:1.text: Next, we shall require the aid of the two acolytes. You must seize the moment when their consciousness returns and wield the power of Divine Light to purify them so that they may find eternal rest.
say:13:1322136011:1.source_cn: 接下来就需要两位修士先生的帮助了。你们得抓住他们找回自...

say:14:1322136012:1.text: In the name of the goddess, I swear to you that I will do my best to appease the souls of these brave men.
say:14:1322136012:1.source_cn: 以女神之名，我向您发誓，我会尽我的全力去安抚这些英勇之...

say:16:1322136013:1.text: In Dura's name, we will do what we need to do, Lady Valka.
say:16:1322136013:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我们明白该怎么做了，瓦丽卡女士。

say:17:1322136014:1.text: If you permit us, we'll need a few days to prepare. We're not high priests or exorcisers, and we're not skilled in the Divine Light. We'll need to prepare some tools to assist us.
say:17:1322136014:1.source_cn: 如果允许的话，请您给我们几天时间做准备。我们并非高阶圣...

say:18:1322136015:1.text: Certainly, I will find an appropriate location to perform this ritual of purification during this time.
say:18:1322136015:1.source_cn: 当然。我会在这段时间里找一个合适的地方来进行这次净化仪式。

say:19:1322136016:1.text: I shall see you all in a few days time.

choice:9:0:1.text: With the power of the God of Death?
choice:9:0:1.male: With the power of the God of Death?
choice:9:0:1.female: With the power of the God of Death?
